task_definition.task_description: Please check which smart light is in the living room, identify it, see its current status and the current New York time, then turn that living room light on to 70% brightness and make sure the brightness is applied. After that, find the living room smart lock and lock it with PIN 2468, then look up Alice’s contact info, prepare a high-priority app alert saying “Living room light and lock routine completed successfully.”, and finally take a snapshot of the `/ops/iot-routines` workspace and send the notification to Alice through the app.

user_input.query: Please check which smart light is in the living_room, identify it, confirm its current status, and also check the current time in America/New_York. Prepare a high priority app alert with the exact message “Living room light and lock routine completed successfully.” Finally, take a snapshot of the /ops/iot-routines workspace named living-room-routine-snapshot and send the notification to alice through the app channel.
